If $A=LU$ is the LU decomposition of the matrix $A$ given above, what is the value of $l_{42} \cdot u_{24}?$
question.worked_solution:
Let's apply our standard LU factorization algorithm.

We reduce the matrix $A$ to row echelon form to obtain the matrix $U,$ as usual. However, instead of writing zeros below the main diagonal, we will instead write down the entries of the matrix $L.$

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =[\begin{aligned}6 & 6 & -6 & 8 \\ 0 & -2 & 0 & -3 \\ -6 & -6 & 9 & -7 \\ 0 & 4 & 6 & 9\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+1{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}6 & 6 & -6 & 8 \\ 0 & -2 & 0 & -3 \\ -1 & 0 & 3 & 1 \\ 0 & 4 & 6 & 9\end{aligned}] & {R}_{4} & :={R}_{4}+2{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}6 & 6 & -6 & 8 \\ 0 & -2 & 0 & -3 \\ -1 & 0 & 3 & 1 \\ 0 & -2 & 6 & 3\end{aligned}] & {R}_{4} & :={R}_{4}+(-2){R}_{3} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}6 & 6 & -6 & 8 \\ 0 & -2 & 0 & -3 \\ -1 & 0 & 3 & 1 \\ 0 & -2 & \,2\, & 1\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we obtain 
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14239397/assets/7ea3d13032296c2ed0c9f447860a7b6ec7f8ff32a9e7dce6b2d7e51d3cee0cd3.svg)

Finally, since $l_{42}=-2$ and $u_{24}=-3,$ we get

$$
l_{42} \cdot u_{24} = (-2) \cdot (-3) =6.
$$
